CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

3. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 8

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 37

7. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 9
   C. 32
   D. 8

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 33
   C. 14
   D. 22

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 18

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

14. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 45
   D. 30

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 44
   D. 30

18. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 32

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 40
   D. 30

22. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

23. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

24. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 50

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
